statistics_interpretation.uncertainty: 2000 fixed-seed scene-cluster bootstrap draws; image-macro paired differences, conditional on one training seed. Descriptive, no multiple-comparison correction. Not three independent experiments.
statistics_interpretation.added_stage_at_best: Sbest minus its actualLbest parent: AbsRel-0.000066695,CI[-0.000185103,+0.000069922],no clear added gain. RMSE improves0.00035198m and itsCI narrowly excludes0,but effect is tiny; delta1,F1 and band CIs all cross0. Best F1 difference-0.000034135.
statistics_interpretation.added_stage_at_final: Sfinal minus actualLbestparent: AbsRel+0.000053867,CIcrosses0; F1-0.008948676,CI[-0.0126108,-0.00597977]. Other3CIs cross0. Do not confuse Sfinal-Lfinal with added-stage gain.
statistics_interpretation.matched_method_best: All5 S-J CIs cross0. S-R has improved bandAbsRel with CIexcluding0; other4cross0. S-B0 improves AbsRel,RMSE,delta1,band with CIs excluding0 butF1crosses0; most of that benefit was already present in the LoRA parent.
statistics_interpretation.matched_method_final: S-J F1 lower with CIexcluding0; other4cross0. S-L has lowerF1 and betterband with CIs excluding0; overall measurescross0. S-R improvesRMSE/band but lowersF1 with CIs excluding0;AbsRel/delta1cross0. S-B0 depth/band better,F1cross0.
statistics_interpretation.final_minus_best: AbsRel increases0.000120561 (0.12325%relative) and CIcrosses0;F1 falls0.008914541 with CIexcluding0. F1 worsens154/218,improves55,ties9; total predicted edges442476->429295 and matchedGT294164->288101. Other3CIs cross0.

convergence_and_cost.curve: Validation begins at the parentLbest0.097885614 and stays nearly flat. Rawbest100=0.097818919 is only0.06813% better than initialization, below the0.2% patience-reset requirement; no reset,stop1000 after10checks. Trainingloss decreases0.02431->0.02357 while validation plateaus. No explosive instability; late-loss-down/val-up indicatorfalse.
convergence_and_cost.inherited_start: stable_step0 and target<=0.10 windowstarting0 are inherited from an already trained parent, not zero-cost learning. The target is confirmed atSstep200;<=0.09notreached. Stability is a retrospective >=500-step within1% criterion.
convergence_and_cost.budget: S100 itself1000attempts1000successfulupdates,8000exposures80effectiveepochs,AMP0,no failure/restart. Own total474.028s,recordedattempt488.084s. Entireparent1729.040s/3500attempts is charged,combined2203.068s/4500attempts. Best reached afterS100updates but complete-route3600attempts including parent selection.
convergence_and_cost.parameters: 27089 trainableF3 parameters inS plus73728 frozenLoRA adapterparameters retained at inference;100817 total adaptationparameters used.
convergence_and_cost.cost_caveat: S peak is its own stage; whole route also required parentL training. Peaks are reported allocated CUDA memory in each measured training stage, not full process/setup memory. Laptop walltimes are observational; R excludes historical cachepreparation.
